maker: Guangdong Bright Dream Robotics Co., Ltd. (Country Garden)
model: Mortar Spraying Robot (砂浆喷涂机器人)
name: Bright Dream mortar spraying robot
summary: Indoor robot that sprays thin-coat plaster mortar evenly onto precise block walls from an automatic feed, navigating by lidar and BIM; workers then level the coat. Made by Bright Dream in Foshan.

germany.statusNote: No route for a German buyer. Bright Dream lists the robot only on its Chinese website, whose product detail pages are blank, and its global exclusive agent BrightMaster Robotics (BMR) does not offer it. No EU dealer, customer or CE marking found.

specs.label: Application
specs.value: thin-coat plastering of precision block walls indoors
specs.quote: 适用于室内高精砌砖墙体薄抹灰工程施工

specs.label: Navigation
specs.value: lidar and BIM positioning and path planning
specs.quote: 采用激光雷达与BIM技术结合可自主定位导航和智能路径规划

specs.label: Coat thickness
specs.quote: 喷涂厚度根据需求精准可控

notes: Sprays only; levelling is done by hand afterwards (maker).
Mechanism and drive not described; wheels assumed.
Bright Dream says 28 of its robot types are in commercial use; this one is listed as a product, but it is not offered by BMR.
